sources.title: ACF supercomputer building steel-frame milestone
sources.summary: University reports the final structural beam and completed steel frame for the Next National Supercomputer building; external construction is nearing completion. Opening is expected early2028.

sources.title: ACF construction milestone: principal contractor
sources.summary: Principal contractor independently carries the same dated construction milestone and identifies Robertson Construction Central East as builder.

sources.title: CR4 supercomputer preparation project
sources.summary: University estates identifies the project as an extension to CR4 at the Advanced Computing Facility on the Technopole site next to Easter Bush, plus a new plant room. The existing30MVA power supply was installed with CR4 in2020.

sources.title: ACF Bush Estate address: university procurement
sources.publisher: University of Edinburgh via Public Contracts Scotland
sources.attribution: University of Edinburgh via Public Contracts Scotland
sources.summary: University procurement record gives the ACF performance address as Bush Estate, Penicuik EH26 0QA. Used for location only.

sources.title: ACF Building: OpenStreetMap way59574224
sources.summary: Direct OSM API object named ACF Building, with EH26 0QA and Edinburgh University address tags. Existing building bounds are lon[-3.2004260,-3.1985693],lat[55.8552576,55.8560677]; the proposed locator is their centre.

sources.title: Project Jupiter statement on construction permitting
sources.summary: Oracle states that work to date is on the data center campus and buildings are being constructed under county permits. Its statement distinguishes those works from the adjacent microgrid air-permit proceeding.

sources.title: Scala Data Centers Portfolio
sources.summary: Archived undated operator portfolio label underlying the prior July21 claim. July21 was retrieval, not an observed physical-work date. No recent dated exact-HB01 physical-work source was found. Newer campus references can describe the HB02 expansion. The selected July 21 status is only a retrieval of the undated portfolio. Do not change it to completed or cancelled without a matching source.

sources.title: Scala Data Centers Portfolio
sources.summary: Archived undated operator portfolio label underlying the prior July21 claim. July21 was retrieval, not an observed physical-work date. Government-hosted applicant report supports campus construction during first half 2026, replacing the unsupported July 21 date. It does not isolate LP01 or establish that all phases remained in construction after June 30.

sources.title: AZ Quest Panorama Data Centers definitive prospectus, 4 August2026
sources.summary: Prospectus dated August4. PDF page13 identifies the PF01 data centre and substation in Fortaleza. PDF page242 separately lists Fortaleza PhaseI at Praia do Futuro in final construction; it distinguishes completed Tambore substation from this unfinished asset. Planned acquisition is not a statement of operational status.
